updates.title: Ronald breaks the fall and the arm
updates.body: He insists the doorway was not load-bearing and goes under the ceiling to prove it. The System files the arm under production expenses and awards him the stunt credit anyway.

updates.title: Ronald works the rigging above the shot
updates.body: The Stuntman spends Row Nine over the lens, resetting lines nobody asked him to reset. The feed cuts to him twice and finds nothing it can sell.

updates.title: Ronald sticks a three-story landing
updates.body: The stairwell offers a handrail and he declines it. He lands it, mostly, and the standings move five hundred places in his favor before the Warden notices any of them.
